headline: TER Q2 Deep Dive: AI Demand Drives Growth Across Semiconductor Test and Robotics
summary: Semiconductor testing company Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 104% year on year to $1.33 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.25 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 21% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.47 per share was 20.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Teradyne (TER) Beats Q2 Expectations As AI Chip Demand Lifts Q3 Outlook
summary: Teradyne (NasdaqGS:TER) reported Q2 results that beat its own expectations, supported by demand for semiconductor test and robotics equipment. The company issued a strong Q3 revenue outlook, tied to increased testing needs for advanced AI chips in data centers and vehicles. Management highlighted rising investments in wafer fabrication and complex semiconductor testing as key drivers of current business trends.
